articles.title: THE ALL-NEW 2027 KIA EV3 DEBUTS AT NEW YORK INTERNATIONAL AUTO SHOW
articles.mainIdea: THE ALL-NEW 2027 KIA EV3 DEBUTS AT NEW YORK INTERNATIONAL AUTO SHOW
articles.summary: PR Newswire: THE ALL-NEW 2027 KIA EV3 DEBUTS AT NEW YORK INTERNATIONAL AUTO SHOW. The all-new 2027 Kia EV3 made its North American debut today at the New York International Auto Show, setting a new benchmark as the most attainable model in Kia's growing electric vehicle lineup, which includes the popular EV6 and EV9 models. The EV3 is an entry EV SUV that offers many of the advanced amenities of an EV9 in a smart and approachable package. Ultimately, it is designed to deliver efficient, all-electric performance with a compact footprint.
